# Dialog (`dialog`)

Modal dialog, optionally draggable.

Group: Overlays. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/overlays';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createDialog` (types in `dist/web/overlays/dialog.d.ts`): `.mh-overlay.mh-dialog` (`--sm | --lg`): a native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`, centred over a scrim.Focus goes to the first control in the body or footer (or an `[autofocus]` one). Parts: `__panel`, `__header`,`__title`, `__description`, `__close`, `__body`, `__footer`.

```ts
export function createDialog(options: DialogOptions = {}): DialogHandle;

export interface DialogOptions extends OverlayBaseOptions {
  description?: string;
  /** Width cap. Default `medium`. */
  size?: DialogSize;
  /** `alertdialog` for messages that need an answer. */
  role?: 'dialog' | 'alertdialog';
}

export type DialogHandle = OverlayHandle;

export interface OverlayBaseOptions {
  /** Visible title; also the accessible name. */
  title?: string;
  /** Accessible name when there's no visible title. */
  label?: string;
  /** A close button in the header. Default true. */
  closeButton?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the close button. Default "Close". */
  closeLabel?: string;
  /** Escape and a scrim click close it. Default true. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Portals into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element (default `document.body`). */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
  /** Body content. */
  content?: Child | Child[];
  /** Footer content (usually buttons); the footer is hidden when empty. */
  footer?: Child | Child[];
  /** Called on every close, with what closed it (`'api'` for `close()`). */
  onClose?: (reason: OverlayCloseReason) => void;
  onOpen?: () => void;
}

export interface OverlayHandle {
  /** The `<dialog>` root. */
  el: HTMLDialogElement;
  panel: HTMLElement;
  body: HTMLElement;
  footer: HTMLElement;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  isOpen(): boolean;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
  setContent(...children: Child[]): void;
  setFooter(...children: Child[]): void;
  /** Closes immediately and detaches. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createDialog, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const dialog = createDialog({
  title: 'Save as scene',
  description: 'Keeps the current brightness of every light in this room.',
  content: h('p', {}, 'Living room: three lights at 40%, floor lamp off.'),
  footer: [
    createButton({ label: 'Cancel', variant: 'secondary', onClick: () => dialog.close() }).el,
    createButton({ label: 'Save', onClick: () => dialog.close() }).el,
  ],
});

const open = createButton({ label: 'Save as scene', icon: 'add', onClick: () => dialog.open() });

document.body.append(open.el);
```

## React API

`Button` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createButton`.

```ts
export function Button({ variant, size, icon, trailingIcon, loading = false, fullWidth, disabled, className, type = 'button', children, ...rest }: ButtonProps);

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

`Dialog` (types in `dist/react/overlays.d.ts`): `createDialog` as a component (a native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`).

```ts
export function Dialog({ size = 'medium', role = 'dialog', ...props }: DialogProps);

export interface DialogProps extends OverlayProps {
  size?: DialogSize;
  role?: 'dialog' | 'alertdialog';
}

export interface OverlayProps {
  open: boolean;
  /** The user closed it (Escape, scrim, close button, swipe); set `open` to false. Not called when `open` turns false. */
  onClose: (reason: OverlayCloseReason) => void;
  title?: string;
  /** Accessible name when there's no title. */
  label?: string;
  description?: string;
  closeButton?: boolean;
  closeLabel?: string;
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Portals into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element (default `document.body`). */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
  footer?: ReactNode;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Dialog } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function DialogExample() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const close = () => setOpen(false);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="add" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Save as scene
      </Button>
      <Dialog
        open={open}
        onClose={close}
        title="Save as scene"
        description="Keeps the current brightness of every light in this room."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={close}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={close}>Save</Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p>Living room: three lights at 40%, floor lamp off.</p>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}
```
